reason: Different mechanisms at the same location. Ground truth: isPublished lacks a guard for a missing/undefined article before accessing article.draft, causing a TypeError crash on lookups for slugs absent from the articles map (typo'd slug, external link). Reviewer's finding: isPublished lacks the `import.meta.env.DEV ||` short-circuit bypass, causing draft/future content to be hidden (not crashed) during local dev. These describe different triggers (missing article vs. dev-mode draft content), different runtime effects (TypeError/build crash vs. silent content suppression), and different fixes (null guard vs. DEV bypass). This is a same-location, different-bug case, not a paraphrase.
